title: The rack on a holiday
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The laundromat is closed the day after Thanksgiving. Wood puts the digest in the rack anyway, through the mail slot, one at a time. Twenty go through. The owner finds them on the floor Monday and puts them in the rack in order.

panels.composition: The laundromat, dark, CLOSED on the door drawn as blocks. WOOD outside with a stack and BARNABY.

image.prompt: a young man with a small dog standing outside a dark closed laundromat holding a stack of booklets, black and white, no words

panels.composition: A digest going through the mail slot. Folded. Then another.

image.prompt: close on a folded booklet being pushed through a door's mail slot, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Inside, through the glass: digests on the floor in a fan, twenty, the rack above them empty.

image.prompt: seen through a dark shop's glass door: a fan of small booklets on the floor beneath an empty wire rack, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood and the dog walking off. The strip skips to Monday in the corner: the owner, small, kneeling, putting them in the rack in order. Both in one panel. It's allowed.

image.prompt: a young man and a small dog walking away from a dark laundromat, and in the panel's corner a small vignette of a woman kneeling to gather booklets into a rack, black and white, no words
image.notes: Two times in one panel: Friday large, Monday in the corner.

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Through the mail slot. She puts them in order.
